mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates a strong economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where GDPC1 increased for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and retail sales signals a strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% in a month signals a deflationary pressure, which increases real incomes and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP and a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strong economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 increased and UNRATE decreased.
